brief.description: Build Bounty-Box Early Access: a polished dark navy and gold waitlist for founders who want AI to build software within their budget. Heading: Build big. Stay under budget. Capture email with a Join early access button and clear success confirmation. Persist normalized unique emails in Neon Postgres.
